title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey fined DataOne $1.07 million for violating the Air Pollution Control Act after inspectors found 62 natural gas generators, each the size of a tractor trailer, running without permits at its Vineland data center. Each generator is rated at 2,000 kilowatts. The fine is the largest ever issued to a data center operator in the state. The campus is planned to cover 2.6 million square feet and use 350 megawatts, enough for a medium sized city, with part already operating.

The project has drawn noise complaints, and homeowners have filed a federal lawsuit against DataOne. The Cumberland County Health Department has issued violation orders for excessive noise. Governor Mikie Sherrill said data center builders must benefit New Jersey communities and cannot take a free ride. The article does not state DataOne's next steps or whether it will appeal.
